query.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, "$producer" AS unit_id, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.temperature') AS REAL) AS temp_c, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.compressor_current_amps') AS REAL) AS current_amps, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.door_open') AS door_status FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'FreezerTelemetry' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 50) ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT "$when" AS predicted_at, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.target_producer') AS asset_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.health_status') AS health_status, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.predicted_days_to_failure') AS INTEGER) AS days_to_failure, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.action_priority') AS priority, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.fault_prediction') AS fault_details FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MachineryHealthAssessment' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20
